name: pattern-background
blurb: Animated or static pattern backgrounds with grid, dot, or big-dot variants.
description: CSS-based pattern background with three pattern types (grid, dot, big-dot) and five size options. Optionally animates via background-position in eight directions.
use_when: A flexible, performance-conscious pattern background with optional directional animation.
avoid_when: No significant limitations. CSS-based, fully customizable.
a11y: Container with content slot; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. Animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard when enabled.
